title: Marlowe Rewards Programme Terms: Tier Qualification and the Annual Tier Review
content:
**1. Former upgrade clause.** The clause "a membership is upgraded on the posting date on which its calendar-year qualifying spend to date first reaches the threshold of a higher tier" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**2. Straight to the highest tier.** An upgrade moves the membership straight to the highest tier whose threshold is met.

**3. Former start and validity clause.** The clause "the tier start date becomes that posting date and the tier is valid through 31 December of the calendar year that follows the qualifying year" is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**4. Reaching the tier already held.** Reaching the threshold of the tier already held extends the tier's validity in the same way, without changing the tier.

**5. Annual tier review.** On the annual tier review date, each membership whose tier validity has passed is reviewed against its prior-year qualifying spend. That is the qualifying spend on its earning entries less the reversed spend on its reversal entries, both posted in the whole previous calendar year, from 1 January to 31 December. The review works as follows:

- The membership takes the highest tier whose threshold that spend meets.
- It never falls more tier levels below the tier held than the most a membership can fall at one annual tier review.
- The resulting tier is valid through 31 December of the review year.

**6. Mid-year reversals.** Mid-year reversals never lower a tier.

**7. Status.** Tier changes are written only while the membership is in status active. A suspended membership keeps its tier. A review date that passed during the suspension is applied on the reinstatement date, using the same prior-year spend.

**8. Marlowe Rewards Member.** Marlowe Rewards Member never expires.

## The annual review in practice (hypothetical memberships, at most one level down per review)

| Tier held, validity passed | Prior-year qualifying spend meets | Highest tier met | Resulting tier | Valid through |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | the Silver threshold, not Gold | Silver | Marlowe Rewards Gold (one level below Platinum) | 31 December of the review year |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | the Gold threshold | Gold | Marlowe Rewards Gold | 31 December of the review year |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | the Platinum threshold | Platinum | Marlowe Rewards Platinum | 31 December of the review year |

## Clause 7 (hypothetical dates)

A membership is suspended on 20 December and reinstated on 14 February. The 1 January review date fell during the suspension. The review is applied on 14 February, using the same prior-year spend as on 1 January.

superseded_clauses: A membership is upgraded on the posting date on which loyalty_msr_qualifying_spend_ytd first reaches the `tier_qualifying_spend_usd` of a higher tier;
tier_start_date becomes that posting date and tier_valid_through becomes 31 December of the calendar year that follows the qualifying year (`tier_validity_years_after_qualifying_year`).
